newsitem.title: CANADA: Noranda's Heath Steele stays closed Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Noranda's Heath Steele stays closed Tuesday.

text.p: Noranda Inc will keep its Heath Steele zinc and lead mine in New Brunswick closed again on Tuesday, a company spokesman said on Monday.
Underground operations at the mine were suspended on Friday after four workers came in contact with carbon monoxide and carbon dioxide. The four were sent to hospital, but all had now been released.
"Tomorrow we should have a better reading" about when the mine would re-open, Noranda spokesman Gilles Gratton said in an interview.
The mine produces 2,700 tonnes of ore a day.
The accident was the second for Heath Steele in less than a month. On November 4, one man was killed and another injured after a blast in the mine.
The injured man was still in hospital, Gratton said.
An independent committee was looking into safety standards at the mine. The committee would help the company decide when the mine should be re-opened, Gratton said.
